checks.title: Thumbnail chap nhan anh 50x50 den 2000x2000px (2 dau bao gom), resize thuc te ve 250x250 webp; vuot 2000px bi chan client khong thong bao
steps: Upload anh 40x40 (duoi bien), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
Upload anh 50x50 (bien duoi), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 500x500 (giua), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 2000x2000 (bien tren), quan sat ket qua
Upload anh 2500x2500 (vuot bien tren), quan sat ket qua/thong bao
checks.observation_point: Response API cho tung kich thuoc bien + kich thuoc thuc te sau upload thanh cong
checks.expected_result: CONFIRMED_EXPECTED (PO xac nhan gia tri khop chinh xac: 'co the upload anh nam trong khoang 50x50 toi 2000x2000, sau khi upload thi se giam size xuong con 250x250', 2026-09-13 + evidence run CTX-20260913-02 act_ids=ACT-03-RC-005-001/002/003): 40x40 -> POST /api/products/{id}/thumbnail tra 422 'The image dimensions must be between 50x50 and 2000x2000 pixels.'; 50x50/500x500/2000x2000 -> 200 chap nhan, anh duoc server RESIZE THUC TE ve DUNG 250x250px webp qua CDN cdn.ownego.com; 2500x2500 -> KHONG co request nao toi server (chan HOAN TOAN o CLIENT, khong toast/thong bao nao - khoang trong UX rieng, khong phai vi pham rule). LUU Y: PO cung neu tien de 'hien tai dang chua the thuc hien upload' - tien de nay KHONG khop voi run nay (7 lan upload that thanh cong) va co the da loi thoi tai thoi diem PO tra loi; KHONG anh huong toi tinh CONFIRMED_EXPECTED cua phan bien so/resize da khop 100%.

Rui ro last-write-wins (PUT full-replace 8 field, KB-027) duoc PO CHAP NHAN nhu mot quyet dinh san pham co chu dich, KHONG phai gap ky thuat can fix. Khong con can uu tien P1 nhu mot 'lo hong data-integrity chua xac nhan' - da duoc dong chinh thuc.
